result:
Done. No application files touched — only new test files under `src/app/integration/` plus the plan and output under `.test-gen/`.

**What I added** (6 suites, 51 specs, all named `*.integration.spec.ts` so they match `tsconfig.spec.json`'s `src/**/*.spec.ts` and the `integration` path rule):

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `api-client.integration.spec.ts` | Real `TutorialService` + real `ApiInterceptor`: all CRUD urls resolve to `environment.apiUrl`, absolute urls untouched, 500 surfaces to caller |
| `tutorials-list.integration.spec.ts` | List screen: populated / empty / error, search, remove-all + its failure |
| `tutorials-list-drawer.integration.spec.ts` | List + drawer: fetch on select, 404, 500, publish refreshes list, delete closes & reloads |
| `tutorial-details.integration.spec.ts` | `/tutorials/:id` via the real router: load, 404, 500, update, publish/unpublish, delete→navigate |
| `add-tutorial.integration.spec.ts` | Create: success, empty submit, 400, 500, reset |
| `app-shell.integration.spec.ts` | Real `AppRoutingModule`: root redirect, header nav, routed screens, footer |

Network is faked only at the HTTP boundary (`HttpClientTestingModule` — the repo's existing convention; MSW doesn't apply to a Karma/Angular setup).

**Run result:** 73 passing, 3 skipped, 1 failing. The one failure is **pre-existing** — `src/app/services/tutorial.service.spec.ts` injects `TutorialService` with no `HttpClient` provider; it fails on a clean checkout too and I left it alone.

**Findings (all kept as red-but-skipped tests with `KNOWN-DEFECT` comments):**
- **high** — the requested story is unimplemented: nothing calls `GET /api/health` and `app.component.html`'s footer has no "API: ok".
- **medium** — `findByTitle` interpolates the search term into the query string unencoded, so `a&b` becomes two parameters.
- **low** — the list shows "No tutorials yet" while the request is still in flight (and after an error); there is no loading or error state anywhere.
- **low** — every API failure is swallowed into `console.error` with zero user-visible feedback.

Status reported as **PARTIAL**: the health story can't go green, and I couldn't measure line coverage because enabling it would mean editing `angular.json`.
